articles.title: Senate leaves Washington without passing Trump-backed voting bill
bullets: Senators adjourned early Saturday for summer recess.
Trump had demanded action on the SAVE America Act.
Republicans said they may revisit parts of the bill in September.

articles.title: Todd Blanche confirmed as attorney general in overnight Senate vote
bullets: The Senate confirmed Blanche 50-49 early Saturday.
Two Republicans joined Democrats in opposing him.
Blanche had been serving as acting attorney general.

articles.title: Appeals court halts Trump White House ballroom project
bullets: A divided appeals court ordered aboveground work stopped.
The court said Congress had not approved the $400 million project.
Trump said his administration would appeal to the Supreme Court.

articles.title: ICE policy limits release of body camera footage
bullets: ICE says footage will be released only when in the agency’s best interests.
The policy covers incidents involving immigration officers.
The rule comes amid scrutiny of enforcement actions.

articles.title: Trump administration renews effort to remove Fed governor Lisa Cook
bullets: The White House gave Cook until August 26 to contest removal.
Cook denies mortgage fraud allegations cited by the administration.
The move follows a Supreme Court ruling allowing her to remain temporarily.

articles.title: Iran sees leverage in Strait of Hormuz standoff
bullets: AP reported Iran believes it has strategic leverage over the waterway.
The Strait of Hormuz remains central to global energy flows.
Diplomacy and military pressure are shaping the dispute.

articles.title: London pub owners protest plan to curb ‘vertical drinking’
bullets: UK pub landlords criticized proposed limits on standing drinkers.
The plan targets parts of London’s nightlife district.
Politicians and business owners warned of economic harm.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defense agreement
bullets: The countries announced a new defense pact.
The deal deepens security ties among three major Muslim-majority states.
It comes amid heightened Middle East tensions.

articles.title: Maldives youth activists warn islands may become unlivable
bullets: Young activists are pressing for stronger climate action.
Rising seas threaten the low-lying island nation.
The campaign links climate change with housing and economic risks.

articles.title: US Senate passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill
bullets: The bill was negotiated by the late Sen. Lindsey Graham.
It targets Russia with new sanctions and tariff tools.
The measure is intended to support Ukraine.

articles.title: Kochi’s last Cochin Jews work to preserve community history
bullets: AP profiled efforts to preserve Jewish history in Kochi.
The community traces its roots in India back centuries.
Remaining members are documenting archives, memory and heritage.

articles.title: Four Indian sailors killed in missile strike on ship off Ukraine
bullets: Four Indians were among 10 people killed on a merchant vessel.
India condemned attacks on commercial shipping.
One Indian crew member was reported hospitalized in critical condition.

articles.title: Mumbai police detain protesters during NEET row demonstration
bullets: Student groups protested alleged NEET irregularities in Mumbai.
Organizers said about 200 people were detained.
Police blocked access to the protest site near Chaityabhoomi.

articles.title: Calcutta High Court orders arrest of cricketer Abishek Porel in rape case
bullets: The court directed police to arrest Porel and another accused.
Police were told to seize electronic devices to protect evidence.
The case includes rape and criminal intimidation allegations.

articles.title: Magisterial probe ordered into Doda police firing death
bullets: Authorities ordered an inquiry into a man’s death in alleged police firing.
A Special Investigation Team was also formed.
High-speed internet remained suspended in Doda after the incident.

articles.title: Airbnb jumps after stronger-than-expected quarterly results
bullets: Airbnb shares rose 17.4% after its earnings report.
The company beat analyst expectations for profit and revenue.
The move came during a broader Friday market rally.

articles.title: Nvidia rises as tech stocks lift Wall Street
bullets: Nvidia gained 2.3% on Friday.
Large technology stocks led the broader market higher.
The move helped push the Nasdaq up 1.3%.

articles.title: Broadcom advances in AI-led tech rally
bullets: Broadcom rose 1.7% during Friday trading.
The stock was among major tech gainers cited by AP.
Technology shares were the biggest support for the broader market.

articles.title: S&P 500 closes at record after weak jobs data
bullets: The Dow added 151.83 points.
The Nasdaq climbed 342.26 points.

articles.title: Boeing watched after FAA orders 737 Max inspections
bullets: The FAA ordered inspections affecting 471 Boeing 737 Max jets.
The rule follows crack reports in older 737 models.
No cracks had been found in the Max models covered by the order.

articles.title: FAA orders urgent inspections for hundreds of Boeing 737 Max jets
bullets: The finalized rule takes effect September 10.
It applies to certain 737-8, 737-9 and 737-8200 aircraft.
The FAA said the directive addresses a potential unsafe condition.

articles.title: US stocks rise after employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs
bullets: Wall Street rallied after the weak labor-market report.
Treasury yields fell as traders reassessed Fed policy risk.
Major indexes posted a second straight weekly gain.

articles.title: FDA approves Moderna mRNA flu shot for older adults
bullets: The vaccine is called mFlusiva.
It is approved for older people.
The approval expands use of mRNA vaccine technology beyond COVID-19.

articles.title: Jalapeños linked to US salmonella outbreak traced to Mexican farm
bullets: Officials identified a Mexican farm and a US distributor.
The outbreak involved jalapeños served by restaurant chains.
Investigators continued tracing contaminated supply.

articles.title: Trump gets temporary reprieve in BBC financial disclosure case
bullets: A court gave Trump more time before disclosing finances.
The issue stems from litigation involving the BBC.
The reprieve is temporary, according to AP.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s xAI sues Minnesota over AI ‘nudification’ law
bullets: xAI challenged Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation ban.
The law targets AI tools used to create nonconsensual sexual images.
The lawsuit raises free-speech and technology regulation questions.

articles.title: Jury finds Instagram and YouTube liable in social media addiction trial
bullets: A jury found the platforms liable in a landmark case.
The lawsuit centered on alleged harms to young users.
The verdict could influence future platform-liability litigation.

articles.title: Experimental vaccines aim to prevent hereditary colon and uterine cancers
bullets: Researchers are testing vaccines for people with Lynch syndrome.
The condition raises risks for colorectal and uterine cancers.
The trials aim to intercept cancer before it develops.

articles.title: mRNA flu vaccine wins FDA approval for older adults
bullets: Moderna’s mFlusiva uses mRNA vaccine technology.
The FDA approved it for older people.
The decision adds another mRNA product to the US vaccine market.

articles.title: Climate-tech concerns grow as Maldives youth warn of livability threat
bullets: Maldives activists highlighted long-term climate survival risks.
The story focuses on adaptation, infrastructure and advocacy.
Rising seas remain a major technology and policy challenge for island nations.
